integrity: All mathematical and numerical statements have explicit assumptions and reproducible analytic or finite evidence; no empirical validation or independent historical-priority proof.
scientific_limitations: Linear deterministic two-reserve spectral-invasion criterion for one-way wrapped exponential-rate mixtures, not actual ecological survival; complete closely relevant 2012 spacing article unavailable. Many-reserve invariance applies only to a single exponential rate.
title: Memoryless dispersal is the only gap-neutral exponential mixture: a sharp two-reserve spacing law
